verdict.rationale: Maritime's SDK docs describe a dedicated webhooks feature: you subscribe a URL, and the platform POSTs a signed JSON body on every agent lifecycle event, so you don't have to poll. That covers the core of the story, but the evidence is a single first-party snippet. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog beyond agent lifecycle events, retry/delivery-guarantee and signature-verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
